fusions.name: Word to Halt
fusions.desc: After a 0.8 second incantation, speaks a command into the first enemy in its path. It deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited Route
fusions.desc: You recite a route and your ride drives it through a narrow cone 5 tiles long. It deals 30 damage to everything in it and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Driving Recitation
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 15 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Practised Rounds
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
